title: Account Structure & Audits
objectives: Consolidate messy ad accounts into clean, scalable structures

blocks.text: A messy ad account with 50 random ad sets is bleeding money! Let's build a clean, consolidated architecture.
Modern Meta advertising rewards consolidation. Having 2-3 high-budget campaigns exits the learning phase 10x faster than 25 tiny fragmented ad sets.

blocks.title: The Clean 3-Campaign Account Architecture
items: 1. [CBO] Scaling Campaign: Top 15-20% proven winning creative assets with Advantage+ Broad targeting
2. [ABO] Testing Sandbox: 3-4 isolated ad sets testing new hooks and angles weekly
3. [RETARGET] Bottom-of-Funnel: 0-14 day cart abandoners and catalog carousels

blocks.title: The Highway Analogy
blocks.text: A fragmented account is like a traffic jam with 30 narrow single-lane alleys. A consolidated structure is a smooth 6-lane express highway where data flows at maximum speed!

blocks.title: The 10-Point Audit Checklist
items: 4. No active ad sets stuck in Learning Limited
9. GSTIN active on Indian billing invoices
10. At least 1 live creative test per week

quiz.q: Why is a consolidated account structure (2-3 campaigns) vastly superior to running 30 micro ad sets?
options: It concentrates budget and conversion data into fewer machine learning algorithms, allowing campaigns to exit learning rapidly
Meta charges 50% less fee on consolidated accounts
It eliminates the need for video ads
quiz.explain: Consolidation provides the data density (~50 weekly conversions per set) required for algorithmic optimization.

quiz.q: What is the primary benefit of enforcing standardized naming conventions across an agency team?
options: Anyone on the team can audit funnel stage, targeting, and creative variation at a glance without clicking through menus
Meta automatically gives awards for good naming
It prevents billing credit card errors
quiz.explain: Clear naming eliminates human confusion and speeds up reporting and account audits.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a red flag in a 10-point account audit?
options: 5 cold ad sets are actively competing with 70% audience overlap and zero purchaser exclusions
quiz.explain: Heavy audience overlap with missing purchaser exclusions leads to wasted spend and self-competition.

quiz.q: True or False: In a mature account, the creative testing sandbox should run separately from the main scaling campaign.
quiz.explain: True! An isolated testing sandbox ensures unproven creative tests never jeopardize steady scaling performance.

recap: Consolidate fragmented campaigns into Scaling (CBO), Testing (ABO), and Retargeting.
Use structured naming conventions and run the 10-point audit to eliminate leaks.
